answer: Since Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network, you don't need a payoff letter. We confirm the payoff with Meridian electronically the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. The help center doesn't say how to get a car that doesn't run to us, such as towing or pickup, so please contact a store about that.
